newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 613 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 613 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 613 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 51 wheat, 133 corn, 416 soybean, 8 soymeal, 4 soyoil and one oats contract traded, along with one corn call and 2 corn put options.

In overnight trading, corn was down 1/4 cent per bushel, wheat down 1-1/2 to 5-1/2 cents, soybeans up 2-1/2 to down 1/4 cent, soymeal up 10 cents per ton, soyoil up 0.04 cent per lb, and oats up 1/4 cent per bushel.
